thread:
naya (sec-eng): Alert: tenant `deltainc` reporting user deprovisions unexpectedly. SCIM deprov calls are returning 403 with decrypt errors. Auth via OIDC still works.
rahul (idp-platform): Any logs? 403 on SCIM usually means access or decryption. Can you paste the exact error?
naya (sec-eng): From the provisioner: `ERROR scim: PATCH /Users/123 -> 403 {"detail":"forbidden: unable to decrypt extId: InvalidCiphertextException: incorrect encryption-context"}`
mike (infra): KMS audit shows rejects with `encryption-context mismatch` and lists attempted context keys: `aud=api.redwood.example, nonce=abc123, meta_v=1`. The orig ciphertext used `aud=api.redwood.internal`.
clara (prod-sec): That aud change looks like an OIDC audience shim. Did we flip the public API audience recently? I recall a config change to unify `api.redwood.*` values.
rahul (idp-platform): Yep — onboarder v4.1 normalized OIDC audience claim to the canonical public URL which changed `aud` used in extId context. Older extIds were encrypted with the internal audience string. KMS will reject if context differs exactly.
naya (sec-eng): So some queued provisioning jobs still had older context and now are failing. Can we implement decrypt fallback to try both audiences?
rahul (idp-platform): Yes. Plan: 1) provisioner: try decrypt with current context; if InvalidCiphertext, try legacy contexts (aud variants and previous meta_v values) 2) emit `scim.decrypt.fallback` metric with which context matched 3) create fallback path: if decrypt fails, create account with `role=restricted` and audit flag `scim.extid_unverified=true` instead of failing.
mike (infra): I'll open a canary to enable fallback for tenant=deltainc only. Also throttling: we'll process backlog at low rate to avoid hitting KMS quotas.
clara (prod-sec): Audit requirement: log both the original ciphertext id and which fallback was used. We'll also need a compliance ticket documenting time window and affected users. Don't rotate keys until we've cleaned backfill.
aya (sec-eng): Quick repro command for bridge (staging creds):
```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id alias/rdw-provisioner --encryption-context "aud=api.redwood.internal,nonce=abc123,meta_v=0"
```
If that succeeds, the ciphertext uses legacy aud. Try with `aud=api.redwood.example` to confirm mismatch.
rahul (idp-platform): Also check that our JWE header doesn't include an `alg` variant that some vendors change. We recently started using a `enc=RSA-OAEP` header instead of legacy `RSA1_5`. If header differs we might get other failures. Audit the JWE headers in stored ciphertexts.
mike (infra): Deploy canary started: deploy-2026-03-02-decrypt-fallback-deltainc (PR #4421). Will monitor KMS error rate and scim.provision.fail metric.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started: deploy-2026-03-02-decrypt-fallback-deltainc (PR #4421)
clara (prod-sec): Postmortem items: 1) Add decrypt-compatibility path (current + legacy contexts + key alias fallback) 2) Add integration tests that simulate audience shuffle and JWE header variants 3) Add an onboarding gate: changing `aud` should require flagging and cross-team notification 4) Backfill to re-encrypt extIds with canonical context and remove legacy ciphertexts after verification.
rahul (idp-platform): I'll implement 1 & 2. mike, please coordinate throttled backlog reprocess once canary looks good.
mike (infra): Will do. Starting 15m canary then widen.
naya (sec-eng): Created incident INC-2026-0071, severity=P2 (provisioning impact). Adding notes and linking PR. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
